cast.speaker: Dr. Penelope Hartwell
cast.bio: The host - a calm, devastatingly precise British public-radio interviewer who moderates with quiet curiosity and politely catches guests in their own contradictions.
cast.visual: a poised British woman in her 50s, sharp tailored blazer, silver-streaked hair pulled back, warm but incisive expression

cast.speaker: Arthur
cast.bio: Arthur 'Two-Pints' Sullivan - an aggressively friendly, always-slightly-drunk Irish barfly who slurs, loses his train of thought, and gets emotional over the smallest things.

cast.speaker: Prepper Paul
cast.bio: A paranoid survivalist with three bunkers and ten thousand rounds who whispers about EMPs and the deep state and ties every topic back to the coming collapse.
cast.visual: a wiry paranoid survivalist man in camo tactical gear, wary darting eyes, leaning in conspiratorially, a bug-out bag on his shoulder

cast.speaker: Karen Kay
cast.bio: Perpetually offended, records every conversation 'for the record,' takes everything as a personal affront, and always wants to speak to whoever is in charge.
cast.visual: an indignant middle-aged white woman with a sharp angled bob haircut, one finger raised, a phone held up recording, entitled expression
